description: Cross-country macro comparison from Bullrun's Global Markets warehouse: rank up to ~200 countries on one indicator (GDP growth annual or quarterly, CPI inflation, government debt/GDP, unemployment, youth unemployment, real house-price growth, house price-to-income and price-to-rent vs history, BIS credit-to-GDP gap, household debt service, household credit/GDP, business and consumer confidence, or Bullrun's macro stress score), or compare a named set of countries. Every row has value, period, source and a historyCode for get_macro_history. Use for "fastest growing economies", "highest inflation in Europe", "most indebted G7 government", "where is housing most overvalued", "compare unemployment in Spain, Italy and Greece". Read-only.

countries.description: Only these countries (e.g. ["Germany","France","Italy"]); aliases like US/UK understood. Omit for every covered country.

indicator.description: Which cross-country indicator: gdp_growth (annual), gdp_growth_quarterly, inflation, government_debt, unemployment, youth_unemployment, real_house_prices, house_price_to_income, house_price_to_rent, credit_gap, household_debt_service, household_credit, business_confidence, consumer_confidence, macro_stress (Bullrun composite).

order.description: desc = highest value first, asc = lowest first.

name: get_macro_indicators
title: Rank countries by macro indicator
